context.body: Access, cleansing, death, confession, and removal are ordered together.

observations.body: The LORD regulates Aaron’s entrance, offerings, incense, blood, and the two goats for atonement and removal of sins.
observations.label: God provides guarded approach and removal: action

observations.body: Aaron approaches only as commanded; one goat is killed and one bears sins away.
